# Story 01 — Enhance frontend Theme (Nimbus Slate visual polish) (Story: 7)

## Prerequisites

- Story 6 (`fe-theme/6/intake.md`) — CRM Frontend Foundation (design system, `ThemeProvider`, `LocaleProvider`, `AppSidebar`, `Table`, `Badge`, `Status`, `Button`, `EmptyState`, `LoadingState`, admin identity pages) is already merged. All work in this story assumes those primitives exist and are wired up.
- No backend or contract changes. This story is **visual refinement only** on the existing hand-rolled shared components and admin pages; do **not** swap in a component library and do **not** introduce new color/spacing tokens outside `frontend/src/shared/theme/tokens.ts`.

---

## Story Goal

Give the admin area a polished "Nimbus Slate" look — card-elevated content on a soft neutral background, one blue primary action per view, consistent color-coded status/role indicators, and clearer typographic hierarchy — while continuing to render correctly in **dark mode** and **RTL**.

User-visible outcomes on `/admin/users`, `/admin/roles`, `/admin/permissions` (and their sub-routes):

1. Page content sits inside an elevated **card** (surface background + `shadows.sm` + `radii.lg`), not flush against the page bg.
2. Table rows have hover states, a visually distinct header row (uppercase, letterspaced, muted), row dividers, and comfortable cell padding (`spacing.md`/`lg`).
3. The sidebar has its own `surfaceMuted` background and the active route is highlighted (primary text + surfaceMuted background).
4. Status pills use **success** for Active / **neutral** for Inactive; role badges use **info** consistently.
5. Row-level `Delete` action is de-emphasized (danger outline treatment). Solid danger fill is reserved for the destructive button inside `ConfirmDialog`.
6. Page titles have real hierarchy (larger heading + muted subtitle showing row count).
7. Secondary columns (email, description) render in `--color-text-muted`; primary columns (name/code) in `--color-text`.
8. `EmptyState`/`LoadingState` render as centered, iconified panels — not bare text.

**Not in scope:** new palette, layout restructuring (sidebar position, header content), component library swap, dark-mode palette redesign, i18n string changes beyond one added subtitle key per list page.

## Frontend Tasks

> All spacing and colors **must** be `var(--space-*)`, `var(--color-*)`, `var(--radius-*)`, `var(--shadow-*)`. Do not introduce hex codes or hard-coded pixels in the changed CSS.

### 1 — Card-elevated admin content area

**File: `frontend/src/features/admin/AdminLayout.tsx`**

Wrap `{children}` in a new element `<main className={styles.card}>{children}</main>` inside `.content`.

**File: `frontend/src/features/admin/AdminLayout.module.css`**

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **User self-delete disabled row.** `UserListPage.tsx` line 93 (`disabled={row.id === currentUser?.id}`) — the new `danger-outline` variant must render disabled state legibly. The existing `.button:disabled { opacity: 0.6 }` rule at `Button.module.css:16–19` still applies; verify contrast in dark mode.
- **Zero-length role list on a user row.** `UserListPage.tsx` renders nothing when `row.roles` is empty. That's still acceptable; no visual regression.
- **Very long role/permission code.** Info badge should wrap gracefully — do **not** set `white-space: nowrap` on `.badge`. Current CSS at `Badge.module.css:1–11` uses `inline-flex`, which naturally allows the containing cell to wrap.
- **Multiple role badges on one row.** Add spacing between siblings (see task 5). Without spacing, badges collide visually.
- **Sidebar active state on nested routes.** `NavLink` matches on prefix by default; sub-routes like `/admin/users/new` should still highlight the Users item. Verify by navigating in AdminLayout test (task in Test Plan).
- **`AsyncBoundary` never resolves.** The prior loading-state bug referenced in the intake shipped as "Loading…" text; the new `LoadingState` still renders even when nothing resolves — that is intentional (announces via `role="status"`). Do not gate the icon on resolution.
- **RTL sidebar border.** `AppSidebar.module.css:8` uses `border-inline-end` — flips automatically. Confirm in Arabic locale that the border ends up on the visual left side of the sidebar.
- **Dark-mode `--color-surface` shadow.** `darkTheme.shadows.sm` (`tokens.ts:179`) is `rgba(0,0,0,0.30)` — visible against `#1e293b`. Do not swap in a lighter shadow.
- **Table hover on zero rows.** `Table.tsx:19–21` returns the `emptyState` when `rows.length === 0`, so the `tbody tr:hover` rule never applies to the empty case. Safe.

## Migration / Rollback

None. This is a pure visual refactor with no schema, config, or API contract change.

- **Rollback path:** revert the touched CSS module files, `Button.tsx` `ButtonVariant` union, the three list-page delete-button variant changes, the added i18n `subtitle` keys, and the `AdminLayout.tsx` card wrapper. No data or user-visible feature is affected.

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend builds:** run `pnpm --dir frontend build` — expect zero TypeScript errors after the `ButtonVariant` change (grep once to confirm no code references a fifth variant string that would break).
2. **Frontend tests:** run `pnpm --dir frontend test` — every touched test file passes; new assertions from Test Plan pass.
3. **Frontend runs:** run `pnpm --dir frontend dev`, sign in as an admin, navigate to `/admin/users`. Verify:
   - Content sits in an elevated card with visible `shadow-sm` and rounded corners.
   - Sidebar has a distinct `surfaceMuted` background and the **Users** item is highlighted in primary blue.
   - Table header is uppercase/letterspaced/muted with a subtle background band; body rows show a hover state.
   - Status pill for an active user is green; for an inactive user is neutral gray.
   - Role badges render in blue (info) pills.
   - Delete button is an outlined red button (not solid).
   - Page title is larger than surrounding text; a "N users" subtitle appears in muted color.
   - Email column is muted; full-name column is default color.
   - Loading and empty states show an icon + centered layout.
4. **Regression — dark mode:** toggle `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` (via the app's theme toggle or DevTools) and revisit `/admin/users`, `/admin/roles`, `/admin/permissions`. Every rule above must remain readable; no white-on-white or black-on-black.
5. **Regression — RTL:** switch language to Arabic (`LocaleProvider`), revisit `/admin/users`. Sidebar border flips to the right side (visually left of content in RTL), badge dots are on the correct side, table alignment starts from the right, and shadows/spacing remain intact.
6. **Regression — routing:** navigate to `/admin/users/new`, `/admin/users/:id`, `/admin/roles`, `/admin/permissions`. Sidebar active state persists on the appropriate item; card layout unchanged; no console errors.
7. **Backend builds:** N/A (no backend changes).
